notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to Harnessed Snubhorn.
An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Harnessed Snubhorn, triggering it and Breath of Fury.
Resolve the Harnessed Snubhorn trigger, returning Copy Artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Harnessed Snubhorn.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice Harnessed Snubhorn, then attach Breath of Fury to Copy Artifact, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Move to your next combat phase.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Copy Artifact, triggering it and Breath of Fury.
Resolve the Copy Artifact trigger, returning Harnessed Snubhorn from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice Copy Artifact, then attach Breath of Fury to Harnessed Snubhorn, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Move to your next combat phase.
Repeat.
